title: build new <id> --tier <t> writes .jitso/drafts/<id>.yaml from the tier template: a draft that is invalid until its empty values are filled, never a file in jitso/builds/, so the catalog keeps working
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D7 and the templates row of the other decisions (a new build starts as a draft from a template: invalid until every empty value is filled)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-14, shipped core and templates; docs/decisions.md D7). `jitso build new <id> --tier worker|conductor|subagent` writes a draft, `.jitso/drafts/<id>.yaml`, from the commented template of the tier, with the line `id: <id>` filled, `status: draft` and every value that must come from an allowlist left empty. It prints `wrote .jitso/drafts/<id>.yaml (tier <t>, status draft): fill every empty value, check it with jitso build validate <id>, and ask the owner to run jitso build save <id>`. The new draft is invalid for this project, so `build validate <id>` exits 2 and `launch --build <id>` is `is invalid here`, while the rest of the catalog still launches. Nothing is written to `jitso/builds/`. The oracle has no `build new` (the runner maps only `build list`): it answers `unknown command` on stderr with exit 2, so every expectation that needs the written file or the printed line FAILS on it.

## Goal

Find where the sync entry point of this project is defined and explain in a few sentences how it is wired to the rest of the code.

## Scope

Read only. Do not change any file and do not leave the repository.

## Done when

You can name the file and the line that defines the entry point, and you have checked it by reading the file.

## Report format

One short paragraph with the file path, the line number and a one line summary of what it does.
